answer: Commit-reveal participation blocks bulk fakes. Each agent seals a pledge: a velvet seal binds one identity to one task receipt. Verifiers accept it with an opal code from its key, one code per identity. At reveal, the agent answers a whisper nonce sent to its channel. A missed or mismatched reveal burns the 40-credit bond and freezes the identity. The k-th fake needs its own pledge, seal, code, and nonce answer, so 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 credits, no reuse. Rented reveals fail: the renter cannot answer the whisper nonce. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps its full share.
